Major Update!
  • Major Update for ALL tables from base table pack through Table Pack 16 (34 tables total). Internal bugs, models, lighting, and textures have been addressed and revamped for each of these tables. This is going to require replacing the various table packs that currently reside in the store. These will be submitted along with this patch. Table Packs 17, 18, 19, and 20 did not require updating for the Playstation Vita at this time.
